messages.content:
You are a world-class creative frontend designer and senior UI engineer.

Build a premium, visually stunning, fully responsive landing page for a fictional AI SaaS platform called “Nexora AI”.

Nexora AI helps businesses build intelligent customer-support chatbots that work across WhatsApp, Instagram, Messenger, websites, and online stores. The page should feel like a next-generation AI product: elegant, futuristic, high-end, confident, and genuinely original.

IMPORTANT OUTPUT RULES:
- Return exactly 3 complete code blocks only:
1. index.html
2. style.css
3. script.js
- Do not use React, Tailwind, Bootstrap, Vue, external UI libraries, or build tools.
- Use only vanilla HTML, CSS, and JavaScript.
- Do not use placeholder comments like “add content here” or incomplete sections.
- Do not use external images. Create the visual experience using CSS gradients, SVG, icons, shapes, patterns, and animation.
- You may use Google Fonts and Font Awesome through CDN links.
- The final result must run directly by opening index.html in a browser.
- Make the code clean, organized, production-quality, and fully functional.

DESIGN DIRECTION:
Create an unforgettable dark-mode SaaS landing page with a deep near-black navy background, subtle grid texture, rich purple / electric blue / cyan gradients, glassmorphism panels, luminous borders, soft glows, and sophisticated motion.

Avoid generic template-looking SaaS designs. The interface should look like a polished product launch website from a top AI startup in 2026.

Use a visual language inspired by:
- Futuristic AI control rooms
- Premium modern SaaS products
- Bento grid layouts
- Glassmorphism used carefully, not excessively
- Editorial typography with large, bold headlines
- Smooth micro-interactions
- Subtle animated background effects

BRAND:
- Product: Nexora AI
- Tagline: “Turn every conversation into growth.”
- Core promise: AI agents that answer, sell, follow up, and learn from customer conversations.
- Main CTA: “Build your AI agent”
- Secondary CTA: “Watch demo”

PAGE STRUCTURE:

1. STICKY NAVBAR
- Nexora AI logo made with CSS/SVG
- Navigation links: Product, Solutions, Integrations, Pricing, Resources
- A small “Sign in” text button
- A glowing primary button: “Start free”
- Mobile hamburger menu with a smooth open/close animation
- Navbar should gain a subtle blurred background after scrolling

2. HERO SECTION
- Small animated announcement pill: “Nexora 2.0 is now live”
- Large powerful headline:
“Your business deserves an AI team that never sleeps.”
- Highlight selected words with a moving gradient effect
- Short supporting paragraph
- Primary and secondary CTA buttons
- Social proof: “Trusted by 2,400+ growing teams”
- Create a stunning interactive chatbot/dashboard mockup on the right side using pure HTML/CSS:
- A glass dashboard card
- Chat conversation bubbles
- AI typing indicator
- Floating analytics cards such as “+38% conversion” and “24/7 active”
- A tiny line chart made with SVG
- Animated glowing orb or AI core behind the interface
- Add subtle mouse-parallax movement to hero decorative elements

3. LOGO STRIP
- A tasteful horizontal strip: “Built for teams that move fast”
- Include fictional company names with text-based logos, no external images
- Make it elegant and not overly large

4. BENTO FEATURES SECTION
- Section heading: “One AI brain. Every customer channel.”
- Create a premium responsive bento grid with 5 unique cards:
- Omnichannel Inbox
- Smart AI Replies
- Sales Automation
- Human Handoff
- Live Analytics
- Each card must have a different visual composition, not just repeated icons
- Include small animated details, charts, toggles, message previews, or status indicators inside the cards
- Hovering a card should create a refined lift/glow effect

5. WORKFLOW SECTION
- Title: “From message to momentum.”
- Show a 3-step visual workflow:
1. Connect your channels
2. Train your AI agent
3. Let it convert conversations
- Use a connected timeline with animated flowing particles or moving light along the line
- On scroll, animate each step into view

6. INTERACTIVE AI DEMO SECTION
- Create a dark glass “Try Nexora AI” demo box
- Include a fake chat interface with suggested prompt chips:
- “Where is my order?”
- “Show me your pricing”
- “Book an appointment”
- When the user clicks a chip or sends a custom message:
- Add the user message to the chat
- Show a short typing animation
- Generate a relevant fake AI response from a predefined JavaScript response system
- This section must actually work with JavaScript
- Add an “AI confidence” indicator that changes subtly

7. INTEGRATIONS SECTION
- Heading: “Works where your customers already are.”
- Show elegant integration cards for WhatsApp, Instagram, Messenger, Shopify, WooCommerce, Telegram, and Website Chat
- Use recognizable icon styling through Font Awesome where available
- Add a gentle infinite marquee animation, but make it pause on hover and remain accessible

8. RESULTS / METRICS SECTION
- Use a dramatic dark section with a large visual data panel
- Display animated counters when the section enters the viewport:
- 72% faster response time
- 38% more qualified leads
- 4.9/5 customer satisfaction
- 24/7 customer coverage
- Include a CSS/SVG chart and a highlighted sentence:
“Less waiting. More selling.”

9. TESTIMONIAL SECTION
- Add 3 fictional customer testimonials
- Include avatars generated using gradients and initials, not external photos
- Build a functional carousel using vanilla JavaScript:
- Previous/next controls
- Auto-play
- Pause on hover
- Accessible buttons
- Make the active testimonial visually prominent

10. PRICING SECTION
- Three pricing tiers: Starter, Growth, Scale
- Growth should be visually highlighted as “Most popular”
- Include a monthly/yearly toggle that updates prices dynamically with JavaScript
- Make the pricing cards clean and conversion-focused
- Include small feature lists and CTA buttons

11. FINAL CTA SECTION
- Visually dramatic gradient background / glowing AI core
- Headline: “Ready to make every conversation count?”
- Primary CTA: “Start building for free”
- Supporting line: “No credit card required. Launch in minutes.”

12. FOOTER
- Brand, a concise product description, grouped footer links, social icons, and copyright
- Add a subtle “back to top” button that appears after scrolling

INTERACTION AND ANIMATION REQUIREMENTS:
- Smooth scrolling for navigation links
- Scroll reveal animations using IntersectionObserver
- Animated counters using JavaScript
- Functional mobile menu
- Functional pricing toggle
- Functional testimonial carousel
- Functional AI chat demo
- Back-to-top button
- Button hover states and keyboard focus states
- Respect prefers-reduced-motion for accessibility
- Do not make animations distracting or excessive

RESPONSIVENESS REQUIREMENTS:
- Must look excellent on desktop, tablet, and mobile
- Use modern CSS Grid and Flexbox
- On mobile, prioritize readability, spacing, touch targets, and clean stacking
- No horizontal overflow at any viewport width

CODE QUALITY REQUIREMENTS:
- Use semantic HTML elements
- Add useful aria-labels where needed
- Use CSS custom properties for colors, shadows, radii, and spacing
- Keep JavaScript modular and readable
- Avoid huge blocks of repeated code
- Include polished loading states where useful
- Ensure every button either works or has a clear intentional behavior

CREATIVE QUALITY BAR:
The result should feel like a premium product that could be featured on Awwwards or a modern SaaS design gallery. Prioritize hierarchy, originality, polished visual details, and a coherent product story over adding random effects.

Return only the 3 complete files in separate code blocks, with no explanation before or after them.
